summary: Propose an invented town with visible layers of repair and reuse, separating creative heritage atmosphere from reconstruction claims.
objective: Buildings have distinct uses and accessible entrances; labels never identify an invented detail as an authenticated historical fact.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a heritage-inspired fictional town
Use heritage fiction as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Create a fictional old port quarter with repaired shops and courtyards, without claiming a specific historical reconstruction.

principles: Propose an invented town with visible layers of repair and reuse, separating creative heritage atmosphere from reconstruction claims.

implementation: Vary rooflines, wall additions and shop fronts around a coherent street width; indicate which additions are part of the fictional story.

Provide street and courtyard views; use a small everyday activity as the scene focus rather than generic continuous crowd motion.

creative_affordances: Combine with hand-painted, miniature or restrained realism; a real place or era requires its own referenced research and uncertainty labels.
